From a107311d7fdf6b826f3737c4a90fd0e0046e7a3a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Desnes Augusto Nunes do Rosario <desnesn@linux.vnet.ibm.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Feb 2018 16:04:30 -0200
Subject: [PATCH] ibmvnic: fix firmware version when no firmware level has been
 provided by the VIOS server

Older versions of VIOS servers do not send the firmware level in the VPD
buffer for the ibmvnic driver. Thus, not only the current message is mis-
leading but the firmware version in the ethtool will be NULL. Therefore,
this patch fixes the firmware string and its warning.

Fixes: 4e6759be28e4 ("ibmvnic: Feature implementation of VPD for the ibmvnic driver")
Signed-off-by: Desnes A. Nunes do Rosario <desnesn@linux.vnet.ibm.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/ibm/ibmvnic.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/ibm/ibmvnic.c
index 8c3058d5d191..7f0bea2104ab 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/ibm/ibmvnic.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/ibm/ibmvnic.c
@@ -3305,7 +3305,11 @@ static void handle_vpd_rsp(union ibmvnic_crq *crq,
 	 */
 	substr = strnstr(adapter->vpd->buff, "RM", adapter->vpd->len);
 	if (!substr) {
-		dev_info(dev, "No FW level provided by VPD\n");
+		dev_info(dev, "Warning - No FW level has been provided in the VPD buffer by the VIOS Server\n");
+		ptr = strncpy((char *)adapter->fw_version, "N/A",
+			      3 * sizeof(char));
+		if (!ptr)
+			dev_err(dev, "Failed to inform that firmware version is unavailable to the adapter\n");
 		goto complete;
 	}
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/net/ethernet/ibm/ibmvnic.c`**
1. **Log Message Update**: The log message for when no firmware level is provided by the VPD has been changed from "No FW level provided by VPD" to "Warning - No FW level has been provided in the VPD buffer by the VIOS Server".
2. **Firmware Version Handling**: When no firmware level is found, the firmware version is now set to "N/A" instead of being left as NULL. This is done using `strncpy` to copy "N/A" into `adapter->fw_version`.
3. **Error Handling**: An error check has been added after attempting to set the firmware version. If the `strncpy` operation fails, an error message is logged indicating the failure to inform that the firmware version is unavailable.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications are related in that they address the same issue: the absence of a firmware level from the VIOS server. The updated log message provides clearer information to the user about the situation, while the change to set the firmware version to "N/A" ensures that the system reflects this state accurately. The added error handling enhances robustness by ensuring that any failure in setting the firmware version is logged, thus improving the overall reliability of the firmware reporting mechanism in the ibmvnic driver.
